verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim CodeRabbit finds substantive defects such as runtime errors, null pointer exceptions, race conditions, logic flaws and memory leaks, in PRs and in the CLI. Hands-on community reports back this up, including one saying it catches bugs Claude Code misses and others calling its reviews actionable. However, one team removed it as too verbose, prone to false positives, and never adding anything useful, which undercuts the 'not just nits' part of the story. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of signal-to-noise and false-positive rates, and documented concrete examples of edge-case bugs caught.
